numbers.sentence: One can see that the actor-critic training, especially its AC+LL version, yields significant improvements (1.7 with greedy search and 1.0 with beam search) upon the pure log-likelihood training, which are comparable to those brought by Beam Search Optimization (BSO), even though our log-likelihood baseline is much stronger.

One can see that the actor-critic training, especially its AC+LL version, yields significant improvements (1.7 with greedy search and 1.0 with beam search) upon the pure log-likelihood training, which are comparable to those brought by Beam Search Optimization (BSO), even though our log-likelihood baseline is much stronger.
The actor-critic training brings a significant 1.5 BLEU improvement with greedy search and a noticeable 0.4 BLEU improvement with beam search.

We tried varying the actor update speed , the critic update speed , the value penalty coefficient , whether or not reward shaping is used, whether or not temporal difference (TD) learning is used for the critic.
